ko.executive_summary: Coherent's 1.6T transceiver ramp and approaching CPO revenue milestone signal mainstream adoption of co-packaged optics for AI data centers. NVIDIA's CPO switches enter full-scale mass production via TSMC and Foxconn, establishing silicon photonics as the foundational architecture for next-generation compute interconnects. Jabil debuts a 1.6T DR8 LRO transceiver using Thin-Film Lithium Niobate modulators and Credo DSP, operating at under 13W and architected for 400G per lane.
key_facts: Jabil 1.6T DR8 LRO optical transceiver: 200G per lane today, architected for 400G, power consumption under 13W
Jabil transceiver integrates Thin-Film Lithium Niobate (TFLN) modulator from HyperLight and Credo half-retimed DSP
NVIDIA CPO switches in full-scale mass production; TSMC and Foxconn lead supply chain
Sivers Semiconductors and SemiNex $3.4M InP program targeting AI data centers
OIF multi-vendor interoperability showcase at ECOC 2026 (September 21–23, Malaga): 39 member companies, focus on 448G/224G CEI, CMIS, Co-Packaging
Coherent Q4 FY 2026: 1.6T transceiver ramp, CPO revenue approaching key milestone
Coractive launched double-clad Erbium-Ytterbium Doped Fiber (EYDF) for high-power optical amplifier applications
Focuslight pitch error measurement system targets high-precision Fiber Array Unit (FAU) manufacturing
Taara silicon photonics module with proprietary optical phased array for wireless optical communication

implications.text: Multiple suppliers (Jabil, Coherent) ramping 1.6T transceivers signals industry convergence; 400G per-lane architecture emerging as post-1.6T roadmap target.
NVIDIA mass production + Coherent revenue milestone + Lightmatter/OCP initiative indicate CPO shifting from niche to mainstream data-center interconnect; supply chain scaling via TSMC/Foxconn.
TFLN modulators (HyperLight), optical phased arrays (Taara), and integrated photonic platforms becoming standard building blocks; node/power efficiency gains driving AI workload economics.
OIF's 39-company ECOC demo signals industry-wide commitment to open standards (448G/224G CEI, CMIS); reduces vendor lock-in risk and accelerates ecosystem maturation.
Coractive EYDF and Focuslight FAU measurement systems address bottlenecks in optical amplifier and connector manufacturing; critical for supporting high-channel-count CPO/transceiver scaling.

ko.counterpoint: Coherent's CPO revenue 'approaching' threshold (not yet at inflection) and NVIDIA's supply chain concentrated at TSMC/Foxconn introduce risk; sustained demand growth and geopolitical resilience remain unproven.
